title: punch in and out
questions: how do I punch in
how can I check out
how do I record my attendance
answer: Tap the round punch button in the middle of the bottom bar. The app checks your device, then verifies you by the method your company uses (location, Wi-Fi, QR code, Bluetooth or NFC), and sometimes a face check. You will see a success or failure message.

title: punch rejected
questions: why was my punch rejected
why can't I punch in
my fingerprint failed
answer: A punch can be rejected for these reasons: you are outside the allowed location, you are not on the office Wi-Fi, the QR code or beacon was not found, fake GPS or a VPN is on, the phone time is wrong, or the face check failed. Fix the cause (turn off VPN and fake location, enable location, stand near the office) and try again.

title: face check
questions: what is the face check
why does the app ask for my face
how does face verification work
answer: If your company turned it on, the app records a short video with the front camera and asks you to do simple moves like blinking or turning your head. It then compares your face with your profile photo, all on your phone. Look straight at the camera in good light.

title: offline punch
questions: can I punch without internet
what happens to a punch when I am offline
how do I upload offline punches
answer: Yes. Without internet the punch is saved on your phone and uploaded automatically when the connection comes back. You can see the waiting punches on the offline punches screen.

title: my punches
questions: where can I see my punches
how do I view my attendance history
show my attendance log
answer: Open the Fingerprint tab in the bottom bar. It lists your punches day by day. Pick a date to see another day.

title: request a leave
questions: how do I request a leave
how can I take a day off
how do I ask for a vacation
answer: Open the Requests tab and tap +. Choose the leave type, pick the dates, add a reason or an attachment if needed, and submit. Your manager gets notified.

title: request a permission
questions: how do I request a permission
how can I leave early
how do I ask for a few hours off
answer: Open the Requests tab and tap +. Choose the permission type, then set the date and the start and end time, add a reason and submit.

title: request a mission
questions: how do I request a mission
how do I request work from home
how can I register a business trip
answer: Open the Requests tab and tap +. Choose the mission or work-from-home type (the types your company enabled), fill in the dates and details, and submit.

title: request attachment
questions: how do I attach a file to a request
can I add a medical report
how do I upload a document to my request
answer: In the new request form, use the attachment button to take a photo, choose from the gallery or pick a file. Some request types require an attachment.

title: request duration
questions: how are the leave days counted
are weekends counted in my leave
how is the duration calculated
answer: The app counts the duration for you from the dates you pick, and skips weekends and official holidays set by your company. For hour-based requests it counts the hours between the start and end time.

title: track my request
questions: how do I track my request
where can I see the status of my request
has my request been approved
answer: Open the Requests tab, then the Mine list. Tap a request to see its status, the approval steps, your manager's reply and the comments.

title: ask to ignore a request
questions: how do I cancel my request
can I withdraw a request
how do I ask to ignore my request
answer: Open the request from your Mine list and use the ask to ignore action at the bottom. The approver then decides whether to cancel it.

title: remind about a request
questions: how do I remind my manager
my request is taking long
how do I send a reminder
answer: Open the pending request and use the remind action. It sends a reminder to the person who has to approve it.

title: requests calendar

how do I see my requests on a calendar
show the calendar
answer: In the Requests tab, open the calendar view to see your requests on a month calendar. You can tap + there to add a new one.

title: add a task

how do I add a new task
how can I assign a task to someone
answer: Open More, then Tasks, and tap add. Enter the title and description, the dates, who it is assigned to, optional sub-tasks and attachments, then save. Assigning to others may need manager access.
